user.title: Nokturno
user.description: Fill in only the sources and options you want to use — or nothing at all. Even without a single field the integration offers a catalogue and search (through the public Sosáč/Cinemeta database, in Czech with a TMDB key). The values are the same as in the Nokturno add-on for Kodi. Anything can be changed later in the integration settings.

data.fs_password: FastShare — password (playback uses your credit or unlimited plan)
data.luna_token: Luna — token (or the whole install URL)
data.tmdb_api_key: TMDB — API key (optional, but takes precedence even over Luna — Czech titles and descriptions)
data.external_host: Address outside the home network (Tailscale/VPN) — for phone links
data.notify_target: Notifications about downloads and new episodes (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone; empty = HA notification)
data.qbit_username: qBittorrent — username (only if the web UI asks for login)
data.sub_warn_days: Warn N days before WebShare subscription expires (0 = off)
data.sync_key: Sync key for Kodi (copy it into the Nokturno add-on)
data.stats_enabled: Send anonymous statistics (when off, only a random id and version are sent)

reauth_confirm.title: WebShare login
reauth_confirm.description: WebShare rejected the login — check the e-mail and password.

error.ws_network: WebShare did not answer, try again later.

search.name: Search
search.description: Searches for a movie or series in the sources (Luna, Sosáč), directly on WebShare, or in the movie database (`catalog` / `catalog_series` — finds titles no source has yet). Returns results as a response.

streams.name: Streams of a title
streams.description: Returns sorted streams for a title from search (id from the Search service).

play.name: Play
play.description: Plays a title in Kodi (through the Nokturno add-on) or another player (direct link). A query can replace the ID — the first found title is played.

query.name: Query
query.description: Movie/series name; used when the ID is missing (voice, scripts).

stream.name: Stream index
stream.description: Index from the Streams service; empty = best by settings.

url.name: Direct link
url.description: Plays this link instead of searching for a stream.

direct.name: Always direct link
direct.description: Even for Kodi use the direct URL instead of the add-on (no watched tracking).

resolve.name: Get link
resolve.description: Returns the direct HTTP URL of a stream — for an external player (VLC, phone) or Cast.

download.name: Download
download.description: Downloads a stream into the HA folder (default /media/nokturno) — then it is available in the Media Browser too.

send_link.name: Send link to phone
send_link.description: Sends a notification with a stream link; tapping it opens the player on the phone.

cancel_download.name: Cancel download
cancel_download.description: Cancels and removes an item from the download queue.

start_download.name: Start queued download
start_download.description: Starts a waiting item right away, alongside what is already downloading.

detail.name: Title detail from the movie database
detail.description: Description, poster, rating and genres of a title by IMDb id (Cinemeta). For titles no source has yet.

id.name: IMDb id
id.description: For example tt41126967 (from a search with type “catalog”).

episodes.name: Series episodes
episodes.description: Returns the list of episodes (and seasons) of a series from search.

delete_file.name: Delete downloaded file
delete_file.description: Deletes a file from the download folder.

continue_watching.name: Continue watching
continue_watching.description: In-progress titles and next episodes from the Nokturno add-on in Kodi.

remove_progress.name: Remove from Continue watching
remove_progress.description: Resets the title's progress on the given Kodi — it disappears from Continue watching without asking; watched status is not affected.

entity_id.name: Kodi
entity_id.description: The Kodi where the title is in progress (same as in the Continue watching item).

file.name: File
file.description: The `file` field of a `continue_watching` item — carries the title id to remove.

watch_series.name: Watch series
watch_series.description: Adds a series to the watched list (new episodes are announced); with `remove` it removes it.

check_series.name: Check for new episodes
check_series.description: Checks watched series right away (otherwise every 6 hours).

clear_history.name: Clear search history
clear_history.description: Clears the recent queries shown in the card.

clear_cache.name: Clear API cache
clear_cache.description: Clears the cache of searches, streams and catalogues (not history or My list) — forces fresh data.

mark_seen.name: New episode seen
mark_seen.description: Clears the new-episode mark of a watched series (without ID: all).

trakt_auth.name: Connect Trakt.tv
trakt_auth.description: Sends a login code as a notification; after entering it at trakt.tv/activate the account is connected.

trakt_watched.name: Trakt — mark as watched
trakt_watched.description: Writes a movie or episode into the Trakt.tv history (with `remove` it removes it).

trakt_watchlist.name: Trakt — watchlist
trakt_watchlist.description: Loads the Trakt.tv watchlist and finds which titles already have a stream (otherwise runs once a day).

trakt_flag.name: Trakt — mark for further checking
trakt_flag.description: Toggles a manual flag on a watchlist item that already has streams but not in the wanted quality/audio (e.g. 5.1) — keeps it visually separate from titles that are simply ready to watch.

id.name: Title ID
id.description: ID as shown in the watchlist item.

share_file.name: Send downloaded file
share_file.description: Creates a temporary link to a downloaded file through the public HA address (Nabu Casa) and sends it to the phone.

notify_service.name: Notification service
notify_service.description: Empty = target from the integration settings.

want_to_watch.name: Want to watch
want_to_watch.description: Adds a title to the watchlist (checked daily whether it has a stream yet). Without an ID a name is enough — it is watched until the title appears somewhere. With `remove` it removes the item.

id.name: Title ID
id.description: From search results; without it use Name to watch.

query.name: Name to watch
query.description: For titles no source has yet.

series.name: Series ID
series.description: For a saved episode (ID like `tt123:1:3`) — metadata come from it.

favourite_add.name: Move to My List
favourite_add.description: Moves a title from the watchlist into My List (local favourites, shared with Kodi/Stremio) and stops watching/checking it further.

id.name: Title ID
id.description: ID as shown in the watchlist item.

favourite_toggle.name: Add/remove in My List
favourite_toggle.description: Adds a title to My List, or removes it if already saved there — independent of the watchlist.

download_torrent.name: Download torrent
download_torrent.description: Hands a torrent to qBittorrent. The downloaded file ends up in the download folder, where Nokturno offers it like any other downloaded video.

url.name: Link
url.description: Magnet or .torrent address from search results.

torrents.name: Torrents of a title
torrents.description: Searches torrent trackers through Prowlarr. Separate from streams on purpose — trackers answer in seconds, so it runs on demand.

offset.name: Numbering offset
offset.description: How many streams are already listed — torrents continue after them.

fulltext_search.name: Manual full-text search
fulltext_search.description: Searches WebShare, HellSpy, Sledujteto and FastShare with a relaxed filter — finds what regular search discards as a similar but different title. Results are unverified; judgement is left to the user.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where to search — empty tries both.
